chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a hushed entrance into a flooded hall: low watery harp ripples, a single droplet tick, a cool pad opening, the lead's first long note hanging in the echo}
positive_styles: E minor relative to G major
spacious pulse-wave lead with long notes and rests, sinking phrases that do not always climb back
slow submerged low harp arpeggio rolling like deep water
cool string pad with a warm golden glow underneath
deep synth bass swelling like a slow tide
minimal percussion: soft low thud and occasional droplet-like tick
